summary: WF-03 Step 4 REWORK 2 (ISS-0709 / GH #799): fixed the two HTTP-boundary blockers B2 and B3 in tests/integration/validation_vld_http_test.zig. B2: int_vld_03_http_200 was driving happy_graph (conditions "amount > 0" / "amount <= 0") through handleValidate, which passes an EMPTY env (Definition has no variable_schemas column yet — VLD-04 pre-fetches), so `amount` resolved UnknownVariable -> HTTP 422. Added a dedicated literal-only fixture happy_literal_graph (conditions "1 > 0" / "1 <= 0" — number-vs-number comparisons that type-check to .bool with zero env lookups) and pointed int_vld_03_http_200 at it -> genuinely 0 findings -> HTTP 200 + semantically_valid. The shared happy_graph is preserved for int_vld_03_02 (which asserts UnknownVariable findings -> 422, R10-3) and int_vld_03_cross_tenant_404 (graph content is irrelevant — the handler 404s on the tenant-scoped read before validation). B3: int_vld_03_cross_tenant_404 returned 500 not 404 because tenant B was not provisioned — resolveAndCacheStorageMode fell through to LEGACY_RLS (search_path = public), where process_definitions does not exist (sqlstate 42P01). Fixed by provisioning tenant B's physical schema via bpm.provisioning.provisionTenantSchema(alloc, &pool, tenant_b, build_options.migrations_dir) BEFORE the cross-tenant read, plus a cleanupTenantSchema defer (DROP SCHEMA + DELETE public.tenant_schemas/tenant) matching idn05_role_registry_test.zig. The handler's own api_tenant_context.set(tenant_b) then routes the read to the empty tenant_<b> schema -> getById returns DefinitionNotFound -> HTTP 404 (no findings leak). Verification: zig build exit 0; test-integration-vld-http 5/5 passed (0 leaks, no 42P01); test-integration-vld-unit 14/14 (B1 landed by BACKEND-DEV, R7 preserved — no regression); lint_test_isolation.py exit 0 (179 files, no issues). Committed on feature/wf02-vld01-03-20260816 (1c3a6065). B1 was fixed separately by BACKEND-DEV (844c2016); this handoff's http suite is 5/5 from TEST-DESIGNER changes alone.
